description: Wireless networks do not require authentication using strong cryptographic mechanisms. This signal indicates that wireless access may be granted without verifying user or device identity through secure authentication protocols.
applicability: Applicable to all wireless network authentication configurations. Includes 802.1X/EAP authentication, WPA2/WPA3-Enterprise, certificate-based authentication, and RADIUS integration.

metadata.detection_notes: Detected through wireless security configuration review, authentication protocol analysis, and RADIUS/authentication server settings.
